opening.argument: The material shows a channel and browser walkthrough of online earning, not a completed financial or account transaction. The channel presents paid-work topics, while the demonstrated pages list microtasks, surveys, registration offers, and work involving sign-ups or proof of completion. A gift-card registration screen displays account fields, but the record does not show credentials being submitted or a payment being made. The bonus and earning references remain part of that broader online-income presentation. They do not, on this evidence, establish a deceptive offer, a required investment, victim loss, or a completed transaction.
